note: No data was downloaded for this study. The audit reads only inputs the campaign already committed: the engine's QQQ/QLD*/SPY bars and DTB3, the USD/TRY and Yi-UFE calendars of the after-tax stages, and the extra-data series the re-screened two-leg arms trade as leg B (ief/dgs10/t10yie/shy/gld/lqd/hyg/tip/gdx/sec_xlu/sec_xlp) plus their windows' inputs. `files[]` pins the ones the fix's own evidence touches (SHA-256 computed in this worktree); the framework's full input set is pinned by research/batch_screen/DATA_MANIFEST.json and `python -m research.batch_screen.extra --verify` re-hashes every extra series in place.

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.role: QQQ / QLD* / SPY bars -- the main window, every clean/fresh bootstrap chunk and the leg-A market path the chunk-leg reconstruction mirrors

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.role: DTB3 -- the leg's financing (the 2x recurrence's rate column) and the bootstrap env

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.role: USDTRY -- the after-tax stages' currency conversion (the B1/B2 Δ vectors)

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.role: Yi-UFE -- the Turkish tax indexation (the after-tax bootstrap modes)

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_ief.csv.role: IEF adjusted close -- IC37/IB26/IB26_2L/IC46's leg B (the reported arm's instrument)

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_dgs10.cs.role: DGS10 -- IC37's gate input; also the gapped-series fixture of the availability cells

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_t10yie.c.role: T10YIE -- IC37's gate input (the binding input of the auto window start 2003-01-03)

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_shy.csv.role: SHY adjusted close -- ib25_RW / ib25_2L's leg B

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_gld.csv.role: GLD adjusted close -- IC45's leg B and the harness's late-start availability fixture

data/historical/plugins_d1_lqd.csv.role: LQD adjusted close -- IC31's leg B

data/historical/plugins_d1_gdx.csv.role: GDX adjusted close -- IC35's leg B

data/historical/plugins_d1_tip.csv.role: TIP adjusted close -- IC33's leg B

artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/PRE_FIX_BASELI: the pre-fix bootstrap archive (raw per-path CAGRs over 5 draws x 8 arms x 4 cells) the parity diff is taken against; SHA-256 recorded in PARITY_LEGB.json
artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/PARITY_LEGB.js: the before/after diff: which arms are bit-identical (single-leg, panel-leg) and which the extra-key repair moves
artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/repro.json: the one-path decomposition of the IC37/C B1 Δ (leg-A identity, leg-B spanning columns, tax, pool/start/length)
artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/HARNESS.json: the study harness (engine parity --quick, K anchors, the leg-B convention cells, the parity diff)
artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/RESULTS.json: old (bank_v3 / two_leg_v1 / opts_fix_v1) vs new (rw_fix_v1) Stage-1 cells per re-screened arm
artifacts.research/rw_boot_audit_v1/RUN_TIMING.jso: the measured wall clock of the recorded `--run` (two batch passes + the deflation) and of the byte-identity reference pass
artifacts.research/batch_screen/results/rw_fix_v1/: the re-screen batch (per-arm records, RESULTS.json, SCOREBOARD.md)

parity_cells.note: small path counts (2-8): bit-identity, not sampling

repro_path.note: one drawn chunk, the published draw
